# Third-party logo sources

These files are kept unmodified and are used only to identify the corresponding runtime dependencies in the project and startup branding.

| File | Upstream source | Retrieved |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SDL_logo.png` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/libsdl-org/sdlweb/main/media/SDL_logo.png | 2026-08-13 |
| `SDL_logo_b.png` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/libsdl-org/sdlweb/main/media/SDL_logo_b.png | 2026-08-13 |
| `SDL_logo_clean.png` | derived from upstream `SDL_logo_b.png`; only near-neutral white fringe pixels were made transparent and the transparent canvas was cropped | 2026-08-13 |
| `ffmpeg-logo.svg` | https://ffmpeg.org/pipermail/ffmpeg-devel/attachments/20130806/480593ce/attachment.svg | 2026-08-13 |
| `ffmpeg3d_white.png` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFmpeg/web/master/htdocs/img/ffmpeg3d_white.png | 2026-08-13 |
| `lua-logo.gif` | https://www.lua.org/images/lua-logo.gif | 2026-08-13 |

The SDL asset is the logo currently used on `libsdl.org`. The FFmpeg vector wordmark comes from the FFmpeg project's official development-list archive; the small white mark is retained as an upstream reference but is not used by the current branding composition. Lua.org explicitly permits use of its logo when referring to Lua, subject to the conditions published on its logo page.
